findings: Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts completeRewind restores the prior leaf if branch writing fails; endOutsideBoundary catches persistence errors, though partial ending persistence is a possible recovery concern.

Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/retrospective-plan.ts readSessionSnapshot validates ancestry and completed tool calls and computes safe cuts; continuity snapshots replace replay state at summaries and sibling branches have independent ledgers.
Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts buildContextMessages freezes the projection at the pending instruction and represents failed outcomes as tool errors.
Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/continuity-ledger.ts rewindLedger restores snapshot items while preserving monotonic revision and ID counters.
Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts startRewindCompaction bounds retries/output and withholds failed entries.

Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/continuity-capture.ts captureIntent uses watermark and source-entry deduplication; abort retains the watermark and classifier failure falls back to heuristics. Possible risk: concurrent classification may use stale initial ledger state for contradictory instructions in one scan.

Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/retrospective.ts cloneRetrospectiveSession stages temporary files, reload-validates the root clone, checks source/family hashes, hard-links publication, and rolls back published outputs on error. Likely recovery risk: rollback unlink failure can leave files; temporary cleanup failure only warns.
Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/config.ts invalid hint values are disabled without cross-layer fallback, while invalid start-anchor and handoff values fall back.
